title: Service binary
what: The bmo-discord binary: serve stands the routes up on the loopback with the receiver link, and health asks the running service whether it is ready, in src/bin/bmo-discord.rs.

title: Provider declaration
what: The Discord provider as bmo-chat serves it: key, label, the four modes on their settings, the capabilities, numbering and health, every room question and send forwarded to the gateway, in src/provider.rs.

title: Discord markdown dialect
what: The discord-markdown dialect: marks go out as written, a long answer divided at two thousand characters by bmo-markup, no fold and no fault, in src/dialect.rs.

title: Gateway client
what: The service's one module calling the gateway over the loopback: its health, a send, the room questions and the owner's room, in src/gateway.rs.
